address: 97 High Street, Henley-in-Arden, B95 5AT, United Kingdom
bio: Renowned Midlands chef Glynn Purnell is behind this modern take on a characterful old pub situated on one of the UK’s prettiest high streets. The beamed interior blends the old with the new, as in the elegant bar area complete with roaring woodburner. Diners should head to the rear to enjoy everything from steaks and burgers to their signature black pudding scotch egg and a selection of pies. Prices are keen, service is on the ball and, when the sun is shining, a seat on the terrace overlooking the garden is the icing on the cake....
